Yohiprāpti(lakṣaṇa)
on the changes in the accent of verbs caused by their being compounded with prepositions or being in conjunction with yat in the Taittirīyasaṃhitā. See Aithal, Vedalakṣaṇa, p. 514.
Adyar D.
